# Reports

This folder contains the foundational reports, clinical guidelines, and scientific publications that underpin the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) quality indicators and clinical practices. It houses official annual quality evaluations, supplementary analyses on clinical outcomes like severe bleeding, and the specific operational tools—such as questionnaires and educational tables—used in daily patient care. Additionally, it catalogs the pivotal international and national studies that provide the evidence base for structured patient education and cardiac rehabilitation in atrial fibrillation treatment.

## Pages

- [[afdk-aarsrapport-2023|Årsrapport 2023]] — The official 2023 quality report evaluating atrial fibrillation treatment quality, regional variations, and patient outcomes across Denmark.
- [[afdk-anbefalinger-for-patientundervisningen|AFDK Anbefalinger for patientundervisningen]] — The national guiding framework establishing the mandated content and structure for educating newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[ambuflex-skema|Ambuflex-skema]] — A pre-appointment clinical questionnaire used to tailor individualized patient education in atrial fibrillation clinics.
- [[figur-3|Figur 3]] — A visual overview of risk factors associated with atrial fibrillation, sourced from national clinical guidelines.
- [[palm-et-al-2020|"Palm et al., 2020"]] — A pivotal meta-analysis providing the primary evidence that structured patient education significantly reduces death and hospital readmissions.
- [[risom-2019|"Risom, 2019"]] — A publication supporting national clinical guideline recommendations for cardiac rehabilitation and patient education for newly diagnosed patients.
- [[risom-et-al-2018|"Risom et al., 2018"]] — A qualitative study exploring patients' lived experiences and the crucial role of individualized education in managing disease-related anxiety.
- [[sundhedsstyrelsen-2019|"Sundhedsstyrelsen, 2019"]] — The Danish National Clinical Guideline strongly recommending cardiac rehabilitation containing patient education for newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[supplerende-analyser-7-alvorlig-bloedning|"Supplerende analyser 7: Alvorlig blødning"]] — A dedicated analytical section tracking the incidence of severe bleeding among patients stratified by their anticoagulation treatment type.
- [[tabel-1|Tabel 1]] — A structured overview detailing the recommended, adaptable content elements for patient education in atrial fibrillation care.
- [[van-gelder-et-al-2024|"Van Gelder et al., 2024"]] — The 2024 European Society of Cardiology guidelines serving as the direct international evidence base for patient education quality indicators.
